label: SYNTHETIC_EXPORT_CONFORMANCE_ONLY
meaning: Consumer conformance against the Finance export producer's exact prepared JSON/CSV receipt bytes, produced by synthetic financial postings on a disposable PostgreSQL with a synthetic test-only coherent host authority. Not a mounted host, not a live Product issuer, not CFO delivery, not an actual business run, not a consumer acceptance, not an issue-3 closure.

handoff.name: export-producer-handoff.json
handoff.readBy: the author read the full handoff through the file reader on 2026-10-12; the handoff and the sibling packet directory are outside this sandbox's allowed directories, so no byte-level copy or hash of the handoff file was possible here (see limitations)

committedHere.candidate-receipts/receipt-00.json: receipt 0 in the producer's receipt shape (artifacts then manifest). Authored by transcribing the packet's receipt text; its two artifact byte strings were re-hashed locally and equal the packet's pinned sha256 and byteLength.

candidateReceipts.pendingExactCopy: candidate-receipts/receipt-01..16.json: written, with every one of the 34 artifact byte strings verified against the handoff pins, by `node scripts/prepare-export-conformance.mjs <packet directory>`, which the author's sandbox could not execute (the packet is outside its allowed directories). Until it is run and its output committed, the pinned-artifact suite checks receipt 0 only and reports the other 16 as pending; setting TD_REQUIRE_EXPORT_FIXTURES=1 turns that pending state into a failure.

schemas/ReportingExportManifestSchema.js.origin: schemas/cost-intelligence/2.0.0/integrations/ReportingExportManifestSchema.json at the producer pin; transcribed from the packet source copy and re-hashed locally to the handoff pin
schemas/ReportingExportManifestSchema.js.use: DATA ONLY. A test compares its closed key set and const members with the consumer guard. It is never imported as, or executed as, runtime code.

notCopied: fixtures/reporting/prepared-export-request.json (structural synthetic fixture; it is NOT the actual PostgreSQL request and is not relabelled)
producer runtime source (src/integrations/*.ts) and the synthetic disclosure host (tests/exports/synthetic-disclosure-host.mjs): pinned references in the handoff only, never imported or executed here
earlier source-22 / source-924 Finance v2 conformance inputs: untouched
limitations: Every producer receipt records requestedFormat json; no producer-captured CSV-requested receipt exists. CSV-format behaviour is exercised only with clearly labelled test-built receipts, which are not producer output.
Receipt 1 is the legacy ExportRequest@1.0.0 shape; the Finance v2 consumer refuses it (UNSUPPORTED_SHAPE) by design.
No mounted selected host, no live Product issuer, no coherent live disclosure fence, no CFO delivery or import, no consumer ACK.
